title: Sufficient polynomial completions strengthen the outer bound, not allocation attainability
statement: The later producer source uses four rational output rotations and Gamma to obtain8 cubic generators J with invertible acoustic charge matrix Z. It reports F+Jt+4096(sum|t_j|)^2T globally QC and the quadratic charge completion U=JZ^-1,K=32768 Z^-T Z^-1. Rational decomposition C=Jt+DF.h then gives the explicit sufficient Q_C=kappa|A|^2+(1/2)Fdoubleprime(A)[h,h]+DC_J(A).h for every admitted cubic. The completed final snapshot NOW supplies orbit.py and orbit_bound.json as actual frozen sources, including the reported exact charge decomposition and strict ellipsoid comparison. The source reports K<2^112 P, a strictly stronger ellipsoid in every charge direction; it does not compare full D and D_star in different gauges without proof. Actual-gradient outer bounds still do not yield an attainable Lambda>=rr^T/a. Strict positive capacity margins permit ordinary finite certificates; zero-margin ordinary attainment and full-face QC remain open. The unattained completed-duality allocation question retains actual positive-definite covariance; this does not imply ordinary zero-margin attainment or full-face QC.
